title: Property tax rate change
summary: Changes the Town property tax rate, 50¢ per $100 of assessed value in FY2025-26, on homes and businesses.

how: The Town Manager proposes a budget and tax rate each spring.
Residents comment at a public hearing on the budget.
Town Council adopts the budget ordinance, which sets the rate.

evidence.claim: FY2025-26 rate is 50¢; 1.2¢ was priced at $1.49M
evidence.source: Town of Chapel Hill FY2025-26 budget (The Local Reporter)

evidence.claim: Business activity responds modestly to local taxes
evidence.source: Bartik (1991), Who Benefits from State and Local Economic Development Policies?

pros: A lower rate cuts tax bills for homeowners and businesses.
A higher rate brings in about $1.29 million a year per cent.
cons: A lower rate leaves the Town about $1.29 million a year less per cent.
Much of a cut's saving shows up in higher rents and home values.
A higher rate raises tax bills for homeowners and businesses.
